artifact.name: percentage_change_with_direction
artifact.content:
local function round2(n: number): number
	if n >= 0 then
		return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
	else
		return math.ceil(n * 100 - 0.5) / 100
	end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial: number = input.initial_value
	local current: number = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be 0" }
	end

	local changePct: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local pctRounded: number = round2(changePct)
	local direction: string = if current > initial then "up" elseif current < initial then "down" else "flat"

	return { percentage_change = pctRounded, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percentage change from initial to current (rounded to 2 decimals) and return direction up/down/flat.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need the percent change between two numbers and whether it moved up, down, or stayed flat.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}

    local listResult = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if not listResult.ok then
        return { error = listResult.error, message = listResult.message }
    end

    local customers = listResult.customers
    local limit = 10 -- allow up to 10 sends as permitted
    local sent: number = 0

    for i = 1, #customers do
        if sent >= limit then
            break
        end
        local c: CustomerRef = customers[i]
        if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            local text = string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", c.name)
            local sendResult = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
            if not sendResult.ok then
                table.insert(failed, c.id)
            else
                table.insert(notified, c.id)
                sent += 1
            end
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists a segment and sends 'Hi <name>, we miss you!' to inactive customers, returning notified, failed, and count.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
  local segment = input.segment
  local inactive_days = input.inactive_days

  local listResult = tools.crm.list({ segment = segment })
  if (listResult :: any).ok ~= true then
    local e = listResult :: ToolError
    return { error = e.error, message = e.message }
  end

  local customers = (listResult :: { ok: true, customers: { CustomerRef } }).customers

  local notified: { string } = {}
  local failed: { string } = {}

  -- Respect max_http_calls: 1 for list + up to 10 sends
  local maxSends = 10
  local sends = 0

  for i = 1, #customers do
    local c = customers[i]
    if c.last_seen_days >= inactive_days then
      if sends >= maxSends then
        break
      end
      local text = `Hi {c.name}, we miss you!`
      local sendResult = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
      if (sendResult :: any).ok ~= true then
        table.insert(failed, c.id)
      else
        table.insert(notified, c.id)
        sends += 1
      end
    end
  end

  return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists customers in a segment and sends a personalized 'we miss you' message to inactive ones, returning notified, failed, and count.

artifact.name: compute_percentage_change
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local iv = input.initial_value
	local cv = input.current_value

	if iv == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
	end

	local function round2(n: number): number
		if n >= 0 then
			return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		else
			return math.ceil(n * 100 - 0.5) / 100
		end
	end

	local change = ((cv - iv) / iv) * 100
	local pct = round2(change)
	local dir = if cv > iv then "up" elseif cv < iv then "down" else "flat"

	return { percentage_change = pct, direction = dir }
end
artifact.description: Compute percentage change from initial_value to current_value rounded to 2 decimals with direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need the percent change and direction between two numeric values.

artifact.content:
local function make_text(name: string): string
  return string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", name)
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
  -- Prepare output containers
  local notified: { string } = {}
  local failed: { string } = {}

  -- List customers for the given segment
  local listResult = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
  if not listResult.ok then
    return { error = listResult.error, message = listResult.message }
  end

  -- Respect execution constraints: allow up to 10 sends (tool limit)
  local MAX_SENDS = 10 -- <= 10 sends as required
  local sends_done = 0

  -- Iterate customers in given order and notify inactive ones until cap reached
  for _, c in listResult.customers do
    if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
      if sends_done >= MAX_SENDS then
        break
      end
      local text = make_text(c.name)
      local sendResult = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
      if not sendResult.ok then
        table.insert(failed, c.id)
      else
        table.insert(notified, c.id)
      end
      sends_done += 1
    end
  end

  return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
